audit_declarations.declaration:
theorem BaireCharacterization.exists_clopen_partition.{u_1} {X : Type u_1} [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X]
  [SecondCountableTopology X] (hB : BaireCharacterization.HasClopenBasis X)
  (hK : BaireCharacterization.CompactInteriorEmpty X) {U : Set X} (hU : IsClopen U) (hne : Set.Nonempty U) {ε : Real}
  (hε : LT.lt 0 ε) :
  Exists fun V =>
    And (Eq (Set.iUnion fun n => V n) U)
      (And (Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (V i) (V j))
        (∀ (n : Nat),
          And (IsClopen (V n))
            (And (Set.Nonempty (V n)) (And (LE.le (V n) U) (LE.le (Metric.ediam (V n)) (ENNReal.ofReal ε))))))
audit_declarations.name: BaireCharacterization.exists_clopen_partition

audit_declarations.declaration:
theorem BaireCharacterization.nonempty_homeomorph_iff.{u_1} (X : Type u_1) [TopologicalSpace X] :
  Iff (Nonempty (Homeomorph X (Nat → Nat)))
    (And (Nonempty X)
      (And (PolishSpace X)
        (And (BaireCharacterization.HasClopenBasis X) (BaireCharacterization.CompactInteriorEmpty X))))

surface.module_doc:
# Alexandrov–Urysohn characterization of Baire space

Classical source: Anush Tserunyan, Introduction to descriptive set theory,
Theorem 5.4 and the companion Problem 26 (retained PDF SHA256
b9cf370dee86d3a1fa6f33bf32411f996eb3f7e3e80cac64bd8fb776f601dcd5). Generic scheme limits are from
Felix Weilacher's Mathlib CantorScheme development. The limit, branch-extension
and cylinder-image proofs are adapted from this campaign's OpenBaire package
(frozen source 87652c909a92afded15aad86a901d8c11dd75ed8), with the new
disjoint clopen partition construction supplying injectivity and homeomorphism.
